title: dev.agentpod.thought.delta
description: One delta of a turn's reasoning, sent to the reader's own devices as a to-device event while the turn runs: never stored in a room. Delivery is at-least-once and unordered, so `text` is everything so far and `seq` orders it; a reader applies the highest seq it has seen for the turn. Carries no version: it changes only additively. Pacing is AgentPod's. Mirrors AgentPod's `LiveThoughtDelta` (`packages/contract/src/matrix-events.ts`): the same body as dev.agentpod.stream.delta under a different type, so a reader can tell thinking from the answer. Reasoning never reaches a room. Readers ignore properties they do not know.

room_id.description: The room the turn is answering in.

session_id.description: A turn-scoped id: a new value starts a new turn. The AgentPod hub sends the ACP session id of the turn it is streaming; the Hermes plugin sends the turn's own id (falling back to Hermes's session id), so a straggler from an earlier turn is never mistaken for this one.

seq.description: Monotonic within a turn. A reader drops anything older than what it has.

text.description: Everything so far this turn, never the increment.

done.description: True on the last delta of a turn.
